summary:
Implemented Left menu 4 as a two-level dashboard menu. Level 1 now shows Home, Feedback, and Configure; Feedback and Configure expand/collapse submenu links without navigating, while Home remains a direct navigation item. Added submenu destination pages with matching headings: Provide Feedback, Past Feedbacks, Profile, and Change Password. Preserved the existing feedback request upload workflow under Provide Feedback. Updated nested menu styling and source-level regression coverage. Verification run: `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, `npm.cmd run lint`, `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs`, and `node --test (Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File .ai_factory\tests\unit -Filter *.mjs).FullName` all passed. Browser/Playwright verification was not run per task restriction and remains pending for the controller.

Approved local Playwright runner passed. Evidence: .ai_factory/tests/reports/local-runner/d8c49425-ee5a-4399-bf43-03d048abc9d7/delivery-1-build-1-47d81f08-3ec5-44fe-afd3-4288fc161878.json.
